race.comment: GUNAI RAMBO (4) has an excellent record over this course and distance having never missed the placings in four starts, including three wins. Comes off a (19.20) win last time, scoring by a neck in a Mix 6/7 H over 350m at this track. Looks suited and should go close. ROARING ENGINE (1) missed the frame two back but wound up strongly last time, finishing on late when third (19.28) in a Mix 6/7 H at this track. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card last start despite being beaten. Expected to feature again. NOT PERFECT (6) recorded a 4 length win (19.29) in a Mix 6/7 H last time at this track. Looks a key chance on best figures. SUNNY LYN (7) is worth consideration after filling a hole in a quick run last time.
